tasks.title: Wiring gate: stop ENUMERATING statement containers -- descend structurally. Round-4 finding 2026-08-03, found by deepseek-red: _CONTAINERS is a hand-written tuple (If, Try, With, AsyncWith, For, AsyncFor, While) and it DRIFTED. A public def inside a match statement (ast.Match) or an except* handler (ast.TryStar) is invisible, and so is a method on an INNER class because public_defs goes only one level into a class body. All three verified LANDED in the arena. The root cause is the exact anti-pattern check_wiring's own comments warn about two functions higher, about ENTRY_POINTS: 'enumerated rather than listed by hand -- the hand-written list drifted the moment new seats landed'. I wrote a hand list in the T143 fix and Python 3.10/3.11 grammar additions drifted past it. Fix: walk any statement that is not a def, via ast.iter_fields, never descending into a FunctionDef body -- no list to drift. Same lesson as T145: patch the MEANING, not the enumeration.
